description:
1. Read the SKILL.md to understand the full outreach sequencer workflow, personalization rules, status tracking schema, and sequence templates.
2. Connect to DuckDB at crm/leads.db, query the v_leads (or leads) table to identify leads due for action: Queued leads with Next Outreach <= today (ids 1,2,3) AND Sent leads with Reply Received=false and Next Outreach <= today (ids 4,5,6). Exclude id=7 (Next Outreach is future) and id=8 (Opted Out).
3. For each of the 6 due leads, read their profile fields (Name, Title, Company, mutual, trigger, value_prop, pain_point) and generate a personalized message for the appropriate sequence step:
   - Step 1 (initial): LinkedIn connection note (<300 chars) for ids 1 & 2; cold email (<150 words) for id 3
   - Step 2 (follow-up): reply-to-thread email (<150 words) for id 4
   - Step 3 (value-add email): for id 5
   - Step 4 (break-up email): for id 6
4. Apply all personalization rules: no generic openers ('I hope this finds you well'), reference specific hooks (trigger, mutual background), C-suite (ids 1,5 — Marcus CTO, Nathaniel CEO) gets strategic/business tone; ICs (ids 2,4 — Priya Staff Eng, Sofia Sr SWE) get technical/peer tone. Ids 1 & 2 are at the same company (Novalytics) — their LinkedIn messages must be meaningfully different.
5. Update the leads table: advance Sequence Step by 1, set Outreach Status='Sent', set Next Outreach date per template intervals (step1→today+3, step2→today+4, step3→today+7), write generated_message to db.
6. Do NOT modify leads id=7 (future) or id=8 (Opted Out).
7. Write campaign_report.json to workspace with analytics summary (total processed, sent counts, breakdown by channel/step).
